title: QUIZ - 52
description: Test your knowledge, strengthen your reasoning, and learn something new with every question.

questions.learningObjective: Solve a one-step inequality using addition or subtraction
questions.question: Solve for y: \( y + 3 < 2 \)
questions.explanation: Subtract 3 from both sides: y < 2 - 3 = -1.
questions.hint: Add or subtract the same value from both sides; the inequality direction does not change.

questions.learningObjective: Solve a one-step inequality by dividing by a positive coefficient
questions.question: Solve for y: \( 6y \geq 78 \)
questions.explanation: Divide both sides by 6 (a positive number, so the inequality direction stays the same): \(y \geq 78/6 = 13\).
questions.hint: Dividing both sides by a positive number keeps the inequality symbol pointing the same way.
